_note: Pilot zones in El Salvador's Dry Corridor. Coordinates are representative points for NASA data extraction; confirm final zones with the team and local technicians. NASA POWER uses a ~0.5 x 0.625 degree grid, so each zone must fall in a different grid cell to get distinct data.

zones.name: Chalatenango
zones.description: Northern hillside farms; maize-bean on slopes with high erosion risk.

zones.name: Corinto
zones.description: Northern Morazán hills in the eastern Dry Corridor; long mid-summer drought (canícula) and subsistence maize-bean.

zones.name: Santa Rosa de Lima
zones.description: Hot lowlands near the Gulf of Fonseca; frequent extreme heat days.
